breaking_news.headline: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
breaking_news.summary: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

breaking_news.headline: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
breaking_news.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.

breaking_news.headline: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
breaking_news.summary: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.

breaking_news.headline: For those with criminal records, AI is breaking down barriers to employment
breaking_news.summary: Tens of millions of Americans have criminal records that can be barriers to employment. An AI-powered app is helping those eligible to expunge their records at a pace not seen before.

breaking_news.headline: Apple will invest tariff refund into U.S. manufacturing
breaking_news.summary: Apple says it's planning to invest its hefty tariff refund into U.S. manufacturing. That's a luxury many smaller companies can't afford.

breaking_news.headline: Why Texas is betting 'Y'all Street' can take on Wall Street
breaking_news.summary: Dallas' financial industry is growing amid a larger Texas business boom. But can it really steal New York's crown?

breaking_news.headline: The sneaky economics of healthwashing
breaking_news.summary: Why food companies love labels like "organic" and "high protein," why our brains are misled by them — and how to avoid paying extra for marketing.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX's revenue rises as its once-soaring stock price drifts back to Earth
breaking_news.summary: On their first earnings call since SpaceX's June public offering, executives said the company is pouring funds into rocket development, Starlink satellites and AI.

breaking_news.headline: Man charged with killing Scottish aid worker in Greece
breaking_news.summary: Sharif Ahmadzai, who is 26 and from Afghanistan, faces charges of homicide with intent, robbery and weapons offences.

breaking_news.headline: Air India's new CEO faces financial and safety turbulence
breaking_news.summary: The aftermath of last's year deadly crash and mounting financial losses will be Gebremariam's main challenges.

breaking_news.headline: Outrage as Ugandan football captain beaten to death in street gang attack
breaking_news.summary: The 27-year-old was killed by suspected robbers after resisting an attempt to rob him, police say.

breaking_news.headline: Rihanna is 'in the studio', says partner A$AP Rocky
breaking_news.summary: The singer, who last released a full album in 2016, is in the studio and "cooking", her partner said.

breaking_news.headline: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
breaking_news.summary: There were among seven to be granted humanitarian visas while playing in Australia - but the other five changed their minds and returned to Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Indian journalist Tarun Tejpal sentenced to 10 years in jail for rape
breaking_news.summary: Tejpal, who has denied the accusations, can appeal against the verdict in India's Supreme Court.

breaking_news.headline: In Odesa, no-one is safe from Russia's new Black Sea strikes
breaking_news.summary: Blackened ships and smashed docks mark Russia's recent surge of attacks on Ukraine's coastline.

breaking_news.headline: Thousands of young people missing out on money they don't know about
breaking_news.summary: People aged between 18 and 23 may have thousands in unclaimed government accounts.

breaking_news.headline: Winemakers prosper but veg farms wilt in the drought
breaking_news.summary: Growers in the West of England search for new crops to grow in a changing climate.

breaking_news.headline: US beef prices have soared but farmers aren't making more money
breaking_news.summary: The meat has never been more expensive, due to supply shortages, but there's a big squeeze on profits.

breaking_news.headline: Raleigh owner starts insolvency proceedings
breaking_news.summary: Accell, based in the Netherlands, has owned the famous bike brand since 2012.

breaking_news.headline: Meta becomes latest firm to say its AI hacked another company
breaking_news.summary: Meta is the latest company to disclose an AI agent breach, raising cyber-security concerns.
